name: Serious Sam HD: The First Encounter

achievements.name: Serious Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in single player.

achievements.name: Game Master
achievements.description: Complete the game.

achievements.name: Serious Sam
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player on serious difficulty.

achievements.name: Serious Run
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player by beating estimated time on each level.

achievements.name: Cannon Expert
achievements.description: Pierce at least 10 enemies with a single cannonball.

achievements.name: Perfect Kill
achievements.description: Kill all enemies in Karnak in single player.

achievements.name: Look, it's a secret
achievements.description: Find at least 50 secrets in single player.

achievements.name: Metropolis King
achievements.description: Complete Metropolis level in single player on serious difficulty without loading.

achievements.name: I am invincible
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player without firing a single bullet or shell.

achievements.name: Co-op Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in co-op.

achievements.name: Co-op Hippy
achievements.description: Complete The Great Pyramid in co-op with blood option set to hippy.

achievements.name: Serious Co-op
achievements.description: Complete a co-op game on serious difficulty and extra enemy strength on 400%.

achievements.name: Rocket Jumper
achievements.description: Perform 100 rocket jumps.

achievements.name: Look Ma, I won!
achievements.description: Win a deathmatch.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Master
achievements.description: Win 100 deathmatch games.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Champion
achievements.description: Win 1000 deathmatch games.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Veteran
achievements.description: Complete 100 deathmatches.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Duelist
achievements.description: Win 25 1-on-1 deathmatches.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.description: Win an at least 4 player deathmatch by reaching frag limit of at least 25 without dying.

achievements.name: Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 100 players.

achievements.name: Crazy Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 500 players.

achievements.name: Serious Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 1000 players.

achievements.name: 1337 Fragger
achievements.description: Frag a total of 1337 players.

achievements.name: Desperate Fragger
achievements.description: Frag 25 players with a knife while having no more than 10 health left.

achievements.name: Butcher
achievements.description: Frag 100 players with a knife.

achievements.name: Swordsman
achievements.description: Frag 100 players in a knife-to-knife fight.

achievements.name: Backstabber
achievements.description: Frag 100 players with a knife from behind.

achievements.name: Diverse Fragger
achievements.description: Frag 100 different players in deathmatch.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Marathon
achievements.description: Complete a deathmatch with frag limit set to at least 200. (Frag limit must be reached!)

achievements.name: Deathmatch Marathon Winner
achievements.description: Win a deathmatch marathon.

achievements.name: Grudge
achievements.description: Frag the same player 5 times in a row in at least 4 player deathmatch.

achievements.name: Nemesis
achievements.description: Frag the same player 10 times during a single round in at least 4 player deathmatch.

achievements.name: Frag Combo
achievements.description: Perform 4 frags with each being no more than 10 seconds apart from the previous frag in at least 4 player deathmatch.

achievements.name: Royal Frag Combo
achievements.description: Frag all players in a single frag combo.

achievements.name: Swimming Instructor
achievements.description: Drown an enemy.
